data.name: Mamraj
data.gender_notes: Mamraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, the name Mamraj is derived from the combination of two Sanskrit words: 'mama' meaning moon and 'raj' meaning delight. The name is given to a child born under the influence of the moon and is believed to bring happiness and prosperity. The name Mamraj carries the meaning “Moon's delight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mamraj usually hope their child will grow to embody moon's delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with lunar blessings.
data.etymology: Mamraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon's delight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mamraj total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
